### Funded research projects

**Social Networks and Intergenerational Mobility (SNetMob) · Bocconi University**  
February 2025–present

- **Focus:** Using register data on the whole Dutch population to investigate the effects of social networks in neighborhoods and schools on intergenerational mobility.
- **Role:** Co-PI.
- **Collaborators:** Javier Garcia-Bernardo (Utrecht University); Zachary Parolin (Oxford University); Arnstein Aassve (Bocconi University); Ben Rosche (NYU Abu Dhabi).
- **Funding (among other sources):** Bocconi Senior Grant (SNetMob); €9,877; PI: A. Aassve.

### Research visits & conferences & referee reviews

#### Research visits

##### Oxford University {#oxford-visit}

**6 October–5 December 2026**  
[Institute for New Economic Thinking (INET)](https://www.inet.ox.ac.uk/people/samuel-plach) and [Department of Social Policy and Intervention (DSPI)](https://www.spi.ox.ac.uk/)

I am currently visiting Zach Parolin at INET Oxford, working on my projects on social networks and intergenerational mobility. I am enjoying the vibrant and inspiring community at the University of Oxford through engaging discussions with peers and professors at INET, the Department of Social Policy and Intervention (DSPI), and Nuffield College, as well as talks by world-leading researchers in their fields.
